study_archetype: prospective clinical imaging trial comparing PET tracers for plaque identification

reported_items.raw_name: primary endpoint: comparison of 18F-NaF tissue-to-background ratios between culprit and non-culprit coronary plaques in AMI patients
study design: prospective clinical trial with two patient groups (myocardial infarction and stable angina)
data_or_sample: patient numbers – 40 myocardial infarction, 40 stable angina (PET-CT and invasive coronary angiography)
methods: imaging modalities used – combined PET-CT with 18F-NaF and 18F-FDG; invasive coronary angiography; comparisons with carotid histology and intravascular ultrasound
outcomes: reported main quantitative result – higher median maximum tissue-to-background ratio for culprit vs non-culprit plaques (example values given in abstract)
validation: ex vivo and other-modal validation – 18F-NaF compared with carotid endarterectomy histology and intravascular ultrasound
reported_items.sub_category: histological and IVUS validation of tracer uptake
